title: Default-agent earlier messages
description: AGENT-QUEUE-1: the reply to `GET /v1/agent/default/chat/history?before=<row id>&limit=<1-200, default 100>` - the rows just before the row `before` (no `before`: the newest), oldest first, at most `limit`, budgeted like a snapshot. `earlier` says there are more before them. Core answers from its own rows and reads codex's record a page of 10 turns at a time when it needs older ones (`thread/turns/list`, newest first); a codex that does not page was read whole at attach and is answered from core's copy. Refusals: `409 agent_history_row_unknown` (`before` is no row core has - the conversation changed; read the snapshot again), `400 invalid_request`. Native and web credentials.
